São centenas de sites: filtre com "query" (nome, domínio ou apelido, ex.: "shopee") em vez de listar tudo. A resposta traz "total" (quantos casaram) e "count" (quantos vieram).

tools.name: activate_coupon
tools.description: Reativa um cupom expirado/inativo (de list_coupons com status="expired"), deixando-o vigente de novo. Por padrão remove a expiração (fica vigente sem prazo); informe "expires_at" para definir uma nova validade. Identifique o cupom pelo "id" ou pelo "code".

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "run_command" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "activate_coupon" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, search_products, list_coupons, get_template, get_userbot_config · Public sink: create_offer_post, run_command, get_template, set_template, propose_offer_post · Destructive: run_command, remove_coupon, activate_coupon, get_template, set_template, set_userbot_config, remove_showcase_item.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, search_products, list_coupons, get_template, get_userbot_config · Public sink: create_offer_post, run_command, get_template, set_template, propose_offer_post · Destructive: run_command, remove_coupon, activate_coupon, get_template, set_template, set_userbot_config, remove_showcase_item

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
